scope: This is a bounded recovery from a saved pixel-plan declaration. Investigate and correct the physical subdivision in the southeast area currently merged into CorridorN_SE_open. Its inherited claim that the partial wall fragment is not a separating wall is unverified; assess the original drawing independently rather than treating that claim as evidence. Use the original plan to follow the complete physical divider, its bends and connections at both ends, the full spatial regions on both sides, and any door through that divider. Use your own original-image measurements; the reconstruction and plan_partition references explain the available methods. Keep the existing footprint, calibration, floor height, other partition paths, and all existing aperture geometry unchanged. You may add or correct the local divider, its own internal door, and affected space seeds/roles, and replace contradicted local assumptions with your evidence. A changed physical subdivision will legitimately change which space hosts an unchanged existing aperture; inspect those actual hosts and connections. Do not infer a partition from a desired room count or simplify a nonrectangular space into several physical rooms. If preservation conflicts with the drawing, explicitly report the conflict. Build a viewable candidate, inspect the actual source plan and original overlay including the complete new divider and both adjoining spaces, and select the result if possible. List inherited unresolved limitations honestly. No whole-building fidelity claim is expected from this local task.
only_input: authorized original PNG images, user scope, optional building declaration/mesh, and one unverified saved pixel-plan declaration; no old source BIM, report, GT or evaluation

building_input.image_path_policy: Declared paths are provenance labels only. They are associated by exact basename with the already authorized PNG inventory and are never opened as file paths.

field_semantics.thermal_zones: User declaration for downstream simulation zoning; it is not a measured or authoritative count of physical source spaces.
field_semantics.other_fields: User-supplied building declarations retain their stated meaning and are not ground truth or independently verified observations.

building_input.conflict_policy: The agent must compare declarations with supplied drawing evidence, preserve the conflict or uncertainty, and decide its modelling effect explicitly.

All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level); a 200mm sub-dimension near doors in elevations is treated as threshold/frame annotation, not a raised sill.
Building height 4.5m used uniformly as the single floor's wall height per all four elevations.
